nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: 旧手写提示词（备份，已断开）
widgets_values:
Create a highly realistic 9:16 vertical TikTok-style UGC video using <Product Image 1> as the exact visual reference for the Gensz smart glasses.

CORE STORY:

A young American man is hiking on a beautiful mountain trail while wearing Gensz smart AI glasses.

During the hike, he suddenly notices a small, unusual-looking animal sitting between the rocks.

He has never seen it before.

Without taking out his phone, he looks directly at the animal and naturally says:

"Hi Luma, what animal is that?"

Luma visually analyzes what he is looking at and answers through the glasses:

"That's an American pika. It's a small mountain mammal that lives in cool, rocky alpine areas."

The user is genuinely surprised and impressed.

The entire interaction must feel spontaneous, natural, and realistic.

The key product message is:

SEE SOMETHING UNFAMILIAR →
ASK "HI LUMA" →
LUMA IDENTIFIES IT →
GET THE ANSWER HANDS-FREE.

No phone needed.

---

VIDEO STYLE:

Authentic American TikTok UGC.

Realistic outdoor hiking vlog.

Young American male, around 25–30 years old.

Casual hiking outfit:
lightweight hiking shirt,
hiking pants,
small backpack,
trail shoes.

He is wearing the exact Gensz smart glasses from <Product Image 1>.

Natural, adventurous personality.

No exaggerated influencer acting.

Mountain environment in the United States.

High-altitude rocky trail.

Pine trees in the distance.

Large gray rocks.

Beautiful mountain valley in the background.

Clear daytime weather.

Natural wind.

9:16 vertical.

Realistic 4K appearance.

Natural skin texture.

Realistic sunlight.

Natural shadows.

Slight handheld smartphone movement.

Natural autofocus.

Realistic motion blur.

Authentic outdoor ambience:
wind,
birds,
footsteps on gravel,
distant nature sounds.

The video should feel like a real friend filming a hiking trip.

---

PRODUCT CONSISTENCY:

The Gensz smart glasses must exactly match <Product Image 1>.

Preserve the exact:

frame geometry,
lens shape,
camera module position,
temple thickness,
hinges,
material,
color,
surface texture,
and overall proportions.

Do not redesign the glasses.

Do not make them futuristic.

Do not add glowing lights.

Do not add extra cameras.

The glasses should look like normal stylish eyewear suitable for hiking.

---

SCENE 1 — HIKING UP THE MOUNTAIN

Start with a natural handheld follow shot.

The young American man is walking uphill on a rocky mountain trail.

His friend is filming him vertically from a few steps behind.

The man is breathing slightly heavier from hiking, but still relaxed.

Natural movement.

Real footsteps.

Small backpack moving naturally with his body.

The camera briefly captures the mountain scenery.

The man looks around at the landscape.

He says casually:

"Man, this trail is actually insane."

His friend behind the camera replies:

"Yeah, but this view is worth it."

The man laughs slightly.

He continues hiking.

Do not make this feel scripted.

---

SCENE 2 — DISCOVERING THE ANIMAL

As the man walks near a cluster of large rocks, he suddenly slows down.

He notices movement between the rocks.

The camera naturally follows his line of sight.

A small American pika is sitting on a rock.

The animal should look realistic:

small,
round body,
short rounded ears,
gray-brown fur,
compact face,
realistic proportions.

It should be clearly different from a rabbit or squirrel.

The pika looks around naturally and makes small movements.

The hiker stops.

He looks closely.

He says:

"Wait."

Short pause.

"What is that?"

His friend moves the camera slightly toward the animal.

Friend:

"I have no idea."

The hiker leans forward slightly.

He stays a respectful distance away.

He looks directly at the animal through the Gensz smart glasses.

---

SCENE 3 — ACTIVATING LUMA

Medium close-up from the side.

Keep both the hiker and the direction of the animal visually connected.

The hiker does NOT take out his phone.

He simply looks at the animal and says naturally:

"Hi Luma, what animal is that?"

Short realistic pause.

Luma visually identifies the animal through the glasses.

No scanning animation.

No graphic interface.

No text.

No hologram.

Luma responds through audio:

"That's an American pika. It's a small mountain mammal that lives in cool, rocky alpine areas."

Luma's voice should sound:

clear,
calm,
natural,
modern,
helpful.

The answer should sound like it is being heard through the glasses.

Not like an external narrator.

---

SCENE 4 — NATURAL SURPRISE

The hiker immediately reacts.

He looks back at his friend filming.

Hiker:

"Wait, that's a pika?"

He looks back toward the animal.

Hiker:

"I've literally never seen one of these before."

His friend says:

"You knew that just from looking at it?"

The hiker points lightly toward his glasses.

Hiker:

"No, Luma did."

Natural laugh.

The friend:

"That's actually crazy."

The hiker smiles.

Hiker:

"Yeah, that's actually super useful out here."

Keep the acting subtle and believable.

---

SCENE 5 — ASKING A FOLLOW-UP QUESTION

The pika is still visible nearby.

The hiker remains curious.

He looks directly toward it again.

Hiker:

"Hi Luma, why does it live all the way up here?"

Short pause.

Luma responds:

"Pikas prefer cold mountain environments and usually live around rocky slopes where they can hide from predators."

The hiker nods naturally.

Hiker:

"Okay, that's actually really cool."

His friend asks:

"So you're basically getting a tour guide through your glasses?"

The hiker laughs.

Hiker:

"Pretty much."

This should feel like a spontaneous realization, not an advertisement line.

---

SCENE 6 — CONTINUING THE HIKE

The hikers continue walking up the same trail.

Do not change location dramatically.

The main character keeps wearing the same glasses.

The camera walks beside him.

He says:

"This is the kind of thing I actually like about these."

Friend:

"What?"

Hiker:

"Like, I don't have to stop, pull my phone out, search for something, figure out what I'm looking at..."

He gestures naturally toward the environment.

Hiker:

"I can literally just ask."

Friend:

"That's nice when you're hiking."

Hiker:

"Exactly."

Natural walking continues.

---

SCENE 7 — GENsz PRODUCT MOMENT

The camera moves slightly closer while they continue hiking.

The hiker says casually:

"These are the Gensz smart glasses."

He does not stop and pose.

He continues walking naturally.

Hiker:

"Luma can actually see what I'm looking at, so if I find something weird out here, I can just ask what it is."

He smiles.

Hiker:

"Honestly, that's way more useful than I expected."

The friend says:

"And you didn't touch your phone once."

Hiker:

"Exactly."

---

SCENE 8 — SECOND DISCOVERY / ENDING

As they continue walking, the hiker suddenly notices something else farther up the trail.

Maybe a large bird circling above the mountain or another unusual animal silhouette.

He stops briefly.

He looks upward.

His expression immediately becomes curious again.

Hiker:

"Oh, wait."

His friend laughs because he knows what is about to happen.

Hiker:

"Hi Luma..."

Friend:

"Here we go again."

Both laugh naturally.

The hiker starts asking:

"What kind of bird is—"

Cut naturally before the sentence finishes.

End like a real TikTok hiking clip.

No advertisement end card.

No product poster.

No logo screen.

No text.

---

CRITICAL LUMA INTERACTION LOGIC:

The Gensz glasses can visually understand what the wearer is looking at.

The user activates the assistant verbally.

Correct interaction:

User looks directly at the animal.

User:

"Hi Luma, what animal is that?"

Luma visually analyzes the animal.

Luma:

"That's an American pika. It's a small mountain mammal that lives in cool, rocky alpine areas."

The user may then ask a natural follow-up question:

"Hi Luma, why does it live all the way up here?"

Luma:

"Pikas prefer cold mountain environments and usually live around rocky slopes where they can hide from predators."

All AI information is communicated through AUDIO ONLY.

---

IMPORTANT CAMERA DIRECTION:

The viewer must clearly understand what the smart glasses are seeing.

When the hiker notices the animal:

first show the hiker looking toward the rocks,

then naturally show the pika from his viewing direction,

then return to the hiker as he asks:

"Hi Luma, what animal is that?"

After Luma answers, briefly show the same pika again.

Do not switch to a different animal.

Do not change the animal's appearance.

Do not randomly cut to stock wildlife footage.

The animal and the human must feel like they are genuinely in the same physical environment.

---

AMERICAN ENGLISH PERFORMANCE:

All English dialogue should sound like natural conversational American English.

Recommended delivery:

"Wait. What is that?"

curious and slightly surprised.

"Hi Luma, what animal is that?"

casual and natural, not shouted.

"Wait, that's a pika?"

genuine surprise.

"I've literally never seen one of these before."

natural American TikTok-style speech.

"Yeah, that's actually super useful out here."

relaxed approval.

"Honestly, that's way more useful than I expected."

casual product realization.

Use realistic pauses,
small breaths,
natural laughter,
accurate lip synchronization,
subtle facial expressions.

No professional commercial voice-over.

No robotic human acting.

---

STRICT NO-TEXT REQUIREMENTS:

ABSOLUTELY NO SUBTITLES.

NO CAPTIONS.

NO CLOSED CAPTIONS.

NO AUTO-GENERATED SUBTITLES.

NO WORDS ON SCREEN.

NO ANIMAL LABEL.

NO SPECIES NAME TEXT.

NO AI ANSWER TEXT.

NO FLOATING INFORMATION.

NO AR MARKERS.

NO ANIMAL TARGET BOX.

NO SCANNING EFFECT.

NO HOLOGRAM.

NO SCI-FI HUD.

NO TEXT INSIDE THE GLASSES.

NO PRODUCT FEATURE TEXT.

NO SOCIAL MEDIA UI.

NO WATERMARK.

Luma communicates through AUDIO ONLY.

---

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS:

No phone usage.

No searching on a smartphone.

No taking photos to identify the animal.

No typing.

No fake hologram.

No scanning beam.

No futuristic graphics.

No glowing glasses.

No animal deformation.

No oversized pika.

No rabbit-like pika.

No animal changing species.

No animal teleportation.

No character changes.

No face changes.

No clothing changes.

No backpack changes.

No product deformation.

No glasses disappearing.

No extra camera modules.

No extra fingers.

No distorted hands.

No warped face.

No unrealistic mountain scenery.

No sudden weather changes.

No random location changes.

No studio lighting.

No luxury commercial style.

No overly cinematic advertisement feeling.

---

FINAL TARGET:

The final video should feel like a real American hiking TikTok where a young man unexpectedly sees an unusual wild animal on a mountain trail.

He does not know what it is.

Instead of taking out his phone, he simply looks at it and says:

"Hi Luma, what animal is that?"

Luma immediately identifies it:

"That's an American pika. It's a small mountain mammal that lives in cool, rocky alpine areas."

The hiker is genuinely impressed because the interaction is fast, natural, visual, and completely hands-free.

The audience should immediately understand that Gensz smart glasses can help identify unfamiliar things in the real world simply by looking at them and asking Luma.

The entire video must feel:

adventurous,
natural,
useful,
hands-free,
realistic,
and native to American TikTok UGC.

No subtitles or on-screen text at any moment.

Create a professional English H3 prompt following the reference video action order and camera pacing. Preserve the separately connected product image exactly. Do not invent product functions or nationality. No subtitles, captions or watermarks.
